purpose: Round 6 WS-A — the Founder's two named Golden slices, run end to end so the conservation invariant can be checked on them and only on them. GOLDEN #1 (LS&ĐL 5 Bài 8) is the primary delivery slice WS-C and WS-D are blocked behind; GOLDEN #2 (Toán 4 tập hai Bài 61) is the worst case round 5 measured — 4 trusted / 15 withheld / 32 silently lost, served share 0.211 reported → 0.078 corrected — and is explicitly NOT a learner-facing Math delivery target.
rules: reprocess from the ORIGINAL SOURCE (PDF page + Apple-Vision OCR lines), never from the old units or packs
pages the pipeline cannot process are WITHHELD, never guessed
the same spec is run twice — once with the pre-fix pipeline (1a75d24) and once with the WS-A fix — so before → after is a controlled comparison and not two different populations
